Ready for a new challenge in logistics? Become part of a world-class team at Valeo, the global leader in automotive parts. We’re looking for motivated full-time logistics professionals to join our dynamic facility in Helmond. If you speak English and have experience with order picking, this is your chance!

What are you going to do?
Join the team and help ensure smooth and accurate order processing!

- Order Picking: Use an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT) and hand scanner to pick orders accurately and report discrepancies.
- Packing: Pack products with care, using the correct boxes and labels to ensure safe and timely delivery.
- Continuous Improvement: Contribute to projects that enhance safety, efficiency, and overall performance.

Your schedule:

Monday to Friday, two shifts:

- Morning: 06:00 – 14:00
- Afternoon: 14:00 – 22:00

Accommodation is not included.

What do we offer?
In addition to a gross hourly wage of €16,10 bruto per hour (with 7% shift allowance) that will be paid weekly, we offer:

- 25% overtime allowance and even 50% on Saturdays;
- Travel allowance will be € 0,23 per km (0-35 kilometer single trip);
- Quarterly bonus opportunities;
- 8.33% holiday allowance & 25 days of leave (full-time basis);
- Possibility of a permanent contract and skill development.

Where will you work?
﻿You will be working at Valeo, a manufacturer of car parts. Parts such as clutch plates, windshield wipers and ignition locks are transported throughout Europe from the location in Helmond. The company is easy to reach by car and is located in the lively Eindhoven region. Parking is free. There is a good atmosphere within the company and fun activities are often organized, such as an annual family day. During your break you can enjoy free coffee, tea or soup.

What do we ask?
- You speak and understand English;
- You have experience as an order picker using a hand scanner and EPT;
- You’re safety-conscious and ready to work in a fast-paced environment.

Are you interested?

Are you looking for a job to combine with your studies or family life? Then we have a great opportunity for you! For our warehouse in Ede, we are looking for an order picker and packer for the morning and afternoon shifts. You start your workday by receiving and checking incoming goods. Next you make sure that products are stored in the correct location in the warehouse. Using modern systems such as hand scanners and voice picking, you collect orders. You check if everything is correct and prepare the order for shipment. During your work, you are constantly on the move and actively contribute to a smooth logistics process!

You work in a 2 shift system:

- 07:00 – 16:00 (morning shift)
- 16:00 – 00:00 (afternoon shift)

These two shifts alternate weekly. Additionally, you work one Saturday every four weeks.

- You can speak English or Dutch
- You are available for at least 2 working days per week
- You are willing to work in a 2-shift system
- You are physically capable of performing active work, such as walking and lifting
- Experience is not required, but motivation and commitment are important

Are you an experienced reachtruck driver looking for flexible shift work? We have two shifts available at a large cold storage warehouse in Maastricht, choose what fits your schedule best.

Your responsibilities

- Operating a heated reach truck to move and store goods
- Order picking and ensuring correct product placement
- Identifying and reporting stock discrepancies
- Working according to safety procedures in a cold environment (-25°C)
- Collaborating with colleagues and supervisors

Working in the cold? No problem, thermal clothing is provided and your reach truck is heated.

Available shifts (Monday to Friday)

- Evening/Night shift: flexible start between 15:00 and 22:00

- 32 or 40 hours per week
- Valid reachtruck certificate and relevant experience
- Good command of the English language
- Independent, accurate, and reliable
- Available for at least 32 hours per week

READY TO TAKE YOUR WAREHOUSE SKILLS TO THE NEXT LEVEL?

Are you an experienced warehouse worker and confident operating warehouse equipment? Join DHL Supply Chain in Weert as an EPT, OPT, Reachtruck or Forklift Driver!

Full-time availability – You are available for 40 hours per week.

Relevant experience – Experience with EPT, OPT, reachtruck or forklift work is preferred.

Certificate – A valid certificate for the equipment you operate is a plus.

Own transportation – You can independently travel to and from work.

English skills – You can communicate in English at work.

Safety-minded & reliable – You work carefully, take responsibility and follow safety instructions.

Team player – You enjoy working together with colleagues to get the job done.

Join AYBL as a Warehouse Operative and start immediately!

Looking for temporary full-time work with a fast-growing international sportswear brand? Join AYBL in Halfweg and earn €15.42 gross per hour while working daytime shifts from Monday to Friday. This temporary assignment starts immediately and offers the possibility of extension.

Are you looking for a temporary warehouse job near Amsterdam, Haarlem, or Hoofddorp? AYBL is looking for motivated Warehouse Operatives to support its busy distribution centre during a peak operational period.

As a Warehouse Operative, you will play an important role in ensuring that customer orders are processed quickly and accurately. Working as part of a dynamic team, you will contribute to the efficient flow of goods throughout the warehouse.

Your responsibilities include:

• Order Picking: Using a handheld scanner to collect sportswear and accessories for customer orders.• Packing & Shipping: Checking products, carefully packing orders, and applying shipping labels.• Stock Management: Replenishing stock locations, processing incoming deliveries, and assisting with inventory counts.• Returns Processing: Inspecting returned products and handling them according to warehouse procedures.

You will work in a modern distribution centre where teamwork, accuracy, and productivity are highly valued.

- Available from 7 September for a temporary assignment of at least 2 weeks
- Available full-time (37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday)
- Physically fit and comfortable standing and walking throughout the day
- Accurate, reliable, and motivated to work in a fast-paced environment
- Basic English communication skills for instructions and scanner usage

Join Boston Scientific in Kerkrade and make a real difference! You help ensure that life-saving devices like stents and pacemakers reach hospitals around the world on time. In return, you get a dynamic job, chances to grow, a great work atmosphere, and a salary of €15.25 per hour. Want to be part of a company that changes lives? Apply now!

As a logistic employee, you will be working at the inbound department. Here all medical goods arrive. After the start of the day together with your colleagues, you will be busy with the following tasks:

    - Sorting incoming goods
    
- Registering goods in the system
    
- Moving goods to the correct location in the warehouse

✔️ Performance based annual salary increase, a bonus for achieving team KPI's (3% of gross annual salary) and a 13th month salary

✔️ Reimbursement of travel expenses of €0.21 per kilometer

✔️ Pension accrual via Manpower

✔️ Opportunity to exercise for free (for example with Zumba, spinning or yoga classes) and even massages

✔️ Time for time arrangement

✔️ Excellent growth and development opportunities within Boston Scientific

✔️ €250 referral bonus (after 8 weeks of employment at Boston)

✔️ Positive and supportive work culture

✔️Every day: free fresh fruit on site

- Able to produce a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG)

You’ll be picking and packing orders for both our stores and online customers. It’s physically light work where you’ll get to work with cool automated robots alongside manual systems, so having a good eye for counting numbers is key. Who you are
As our picking and packing specialist, it is important that you meet the following requirements:

- You can work in a 2 shift system ( 7.00-15.00 / 15.00 - 23.00 )

- You understand and speak English

As our new Pick & Pack Specialist, you’ll be at the heart of our fulfillment process! You’ll get to work with an amazing blend of smart warehouse robots and manual systems to process orders for both our aesthetic retail stores and online customers. Armed with a great eye for numbers, you’ll count, double-check, and pack charming Scandinavian products into neat parcels. Step into a modern, high-tech warehouse with a warm Scandinavian feel! At Søstrene Grene, you’ll work alongside friendly colleagues—and futuristic robots—in a clean, well-organized environment. We work in a comfortable 2-shift rotation, keeping the energy high and the teamwork strong.

As a Warehouse employee for GXO, you perform different tasks. From offloading trucks and storing goods on the right location, stock management, picking orders, checking orders or loading trucks with outgoing packages, it is all part of the job. You will be working in an international team in a warm atmosphere. GXO celebrates succeses, so don't be surprised if they hand out icecreams during summer time, or a cake for someones birthday. You will work in a fixed schedule together with your teamleader. One week morning shift from 06.00 to 15.00, next week afternoon shift from 13.00 until 22.00 hrs. Working days are monday to friday. On occasion they work Saturdays. As a warehouse employee you are the key to our clients succes. Its important you pay attention to detail, because the packages you collect are part of a combination. One wrong package and the whole system does not work. 

- You have to have your own transportation (public transport not available at beginning of the shift)
- Full time available from Monday to Friday, in two shifts.
- Physically fit and comfortable with active work (you lift packages up to 25 kg). 
- Speaks good English or Dutch
- VOG required (application will be done after your start).
